d: Bihar ke saran (chhapra) jile ke taraiya thana kshetr ke lauva ganv se is vakt ki bari khabar samne aa rahi hai, jahan jamin vivad ko lekar do pakshon ke bich jamkar hinsak jharap ho gaee. is ghatna ka vidiyo soshal midiya par lagatar vayral ho raha hai. khet ki jutaee rokne ko lekar shuru huaa vivad dekhte hi dekhte khuni sangharsh men badal gaya, jismen char log ghayal ho gae, jabki aakroshit logon ne ek traiktar aur ek jesibi ko aag ke havale kar diya. khet ki jutaee ko lekar bharka vivad, char ghayal:jankari ke anusar, lauva ganv men do pakshon ke bich pahle se jamin vivad chal raha…
